profile.retry: Only transient transport faults restart baseline within shared condition call/token caps, at most three retries. Unknown reservations are charged for admission, never called actual cost. Quality failures are terminal.
profile.timing: Includes execution checks, retries and backoff. Independent audits, preparation and operator pauses excluded. No task deadline.
profile.limitations: Exploratory dev reuse, overlapping component families, one repeat. Different workloads across strata; not an ablation of graph alone. New root differs from packet-all in prompts and output protocol. Evaluation and Manager untouched.
